sn12.4:1.2: “Bhikkhus, before his enlightenment, while he was still a bodhisatta, not yet fully enlightened, it occurred to Vipassı̄, the Blessed One, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One:
sn12.4:1.3: ‘Alas, this world has fallen into trouble, in that it is born, ages, and dies, it passes away and is reborn,
sn12.4:1.4: yet it does not understand the escape from this suffering [headed by] aging-and-death.
sn12.4:1.5: When now will an escape be discerned from this suffering [headed by] aging-and-death?’ … [6–9] …
sn12.4:25.4: “‘Cessation, cessation’—thus, bhikkhus, in regard to things unheard before there arose in the Bodhisatta Vipassı̄ vision, knowledge, wisdom, true knowledge, and light.”
